philippines.title: Marcos yet to accept Lula’s invitation to visit Brazil in 2027 – Palace
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos has yet to formally accept an invitation from Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to visit Brazil next year, according to Malacañang. In a message to reporters on Sunday, Palace press officer Claire Castro said Marcos “warmly received” Lula’s invitation, which included a proposal for the Philippine leader to bring a delegation of business leaders from various industries to strengthen economic ties between the two countries. Marcos described the invitation as “the most convincing” he had ever received and directed concerned government officials to study the proposal. Lula announced the invitation during a press briefing […]...

philippines.title: Town suspends work, classes for Oriental Mindoro founding anniversary
philippines.description:
CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The municipal government of Bansud has suspended work in government offices and classes in all public and private schools on Monday, Nov. 16, in commemoration of the 76th founding anniversary of Oriental Mindoro. In a memorandum Sunday, Municipal Mayor Ronaldo Morada ordered the suspension of work and classes to allow government employees, students, teachers and the public to participate in the province’s anniversary celebration. The province marked its 76th founding anniversary on Sunday. The suspension covers all departments and offices of the Bansud municipal government, concerned government agencies, and public and private schools at all levels […]...
